slide1.headline: OpenAI Daybreak
slide1.subtitle: A new approach to AI security

slide2.title: WHAT HAPPENED
lines: Event date: 23 Jun 2026
OpenAI Daybreak shifts AI security focus from finding to fixing
This approach aims to improve the overall security of AI systems
By focusing on fixing vulnerabilities, OpenAI Daybreak can help prevent attacks
For example, in 2026, AI-powered systems have seen a significant increase in prompt-injection attacks

slide3.title: WHY IT MATTERS
lines: The shift in focus can help prevent attacks and improve the security of AI systems
This approach can also help reduce the risk of data breaches and other security incidents
As AI becomes more prevalent, the need for effective security measures is becoming increasingly important
Source: Cybersecurity Insiders, 23 Jun 2026
